description: Robo's battery is low! Robo charges with a plug, and kids charge with healthy habits: wash your hands, brush your teeth, and get lots of sleep. With muddy Pig, sleepy Cat, and a pepper and soap trick.

youtube.title: Healthy Habits for Kids! 🧼🪥 Wash, Brush, Sleep with Robo | Toy Box Friends
youtube.description:
Uh-oh, Robo's battery is low! Robo charges with a plug, but how do kids charge? With healthy habits! Wash your hands with Pig (wet, soap, scrub for 20 seconds, rinse, dry), see the pepper and soap trick, brush your teeth two times a day with a pea-sized bit of toothpaste, and follow Cat's calm bedtime routine. Lots of sleep charges your body!

Try the pepper trick with a grown-up: water on a plate, a little ground pepper on top, then touch the middle with a soapy finger. Keep pepper away from eyes and noses, and wash your hands after.

Made for kids. Toy Box Friends: 3D learning videos for preschool.

do.text: Beep. Beep. My battery is low!
Only one bar left. I need to charge.
I don't have a battery! How do I charge?
Wash your hands. Brush your teeth. Sleep.
I played in the mud! I love mud!
Pigs roll in mud to keep cool. They cannot sweat much.
Germs are tiny. Too small to see!
Washing helps keep germs off our food.
We wash before we eat, and after the potty!
Three. Scrub for twenty seconds! Say it with me, two times.
Scrub the fronts. Scrub the backs. In between. The thumbs. Bubbles, bubbles, done!
Scrub the fronts. Scrub the backs. In between. The thumbs. Bubbles, bubbles, done!
Let's try a trick. Water on a plate.
A grown-up shakes pepper on top. Pretend the pepper is germs.
First, a plain finger. Touch the middle.
Now put soap on the finger. What will the pepper do?
Whoosh! The pepper zooms away from the soap!
Soap helps wash germs off our hands.
Try it with a grown-up. Keep pepper away from eyes!
A toothbrush. And a pea-sized bit of toothpaste.
Not a big blob. A little pea!
Brush in little circles. Front, back and top.
Brush for two minutes, with a grown-up helping.
When do we brush? Morning and night!
Brush your air teeth with me! Little circles.
No teeth? Oh! My bill has little ridges for grabbing food.
So I clean my feathers instead!
Look. The sun is going down.
Here comes Cat, our sleep expert.
Kids need lots of sleep. All night, and maybe a nap.
Good night, Cat. Good night, Duck. Good night, Pig.
And I charge with my plug.
A quiet quiz. Help charge my battery!
One. What do we use with water to wash our hands?
Two. How many times a day do we brush our teeth?
Three. How much toothpaste? A big blob, or a little pea?
Four. Robo charges with a plug. How do you charge your body?
I am full! You charged me up!
Wash, brush, sleep, every day! Bye-bye!
